script.title: Devastator: The Tantive Capture
script.description: A 160-stud Imperial dagger with smooth armor panels, deep mechanical trenches, eight octuple batteries, three open ion-drive bells, twin geodesic shield domes and a tiny Tantive IV beneath its illuminated ventral bay. Two narrow black cradles leave the silhouette unobstructed.
